milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The purple bed head is at spawn-relative (0,0,6), only 1 block from spawn. max_distance=5 is generous (player already within range), but facing_tolerance=30 requires the player to actually turn and look directly at the bed, preventing trivial instant completion without visual confirmation.

Uses inventory_has because mining white carpet drops it as an item into the player's inventory. Carpet breaks instantly with any tool or bare hand and drops itself. The white carpet is placed beside the purple bed and is not in the player's starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The red nether brick stairs are centered at spawn-relative (6,0,5) in the middle room. max_distance=5 forces the player to walk at least 1 block east from spawn (horizontal distance from spawn is 6), ensuring they enter the middle room. facing_tolerance=45 requires looking toward the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining a quartz block with a pickaxe drops the block itself as an item into inventory. A diamond pickaxe is provided at spawn. The quartz blocks are in the far east room and are not in the player's starting inventory.
